high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from a CNN article on Instagram. The post features two individuals standing side by side against a plain background. Both are dressed in attire that appears to be traditional or semi-traditional clothing, with one wearing a plaid shirt and jeans, and the other in a long, dark-colored garment. The text overlay on the image provides information about a cultural practice in Afghanistan known as "bacha posh," which means "girl dressed up as a boy" in Dari.
